summary:
Iteration 7 — Increment 5 · Phase 1 'Venue Reliability' (feature flag `venue_hours`). Frontend-only, 390x844, against the public preview. ALL nine scenarios A–I PASS. Final GET /api/config/public confirms {experience_profiles:true, experience_builder:true, experience_output:true, venue_hours:true}. No React Native red screens, zero pageerror events captured across the entire session.

A) ADMIN FLAG UI — Logged in via Profile → Log In (auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button) → /admin. All FOUR flag rows + switches present: admin-flag-experience-profiles[-row], admin-flag-experience-builder[-row], admin-flag-experience-output[-row], admin-flag-venue-hours[-row]. Tap admin-flag-venue-hours-row → admin-save-button → GET /api/config/public = {profiles:true, builder:true, output:true, venue_hours:false} ⇒ venue_hours INDEPENDENCE OK (the other three stayed true). Tap row again + Save → venue_hours back to true. Toast assertion was skipped (toast auto-dismisses before the race) but persistence was confirmed via the public config endpoint round-trip.

B) HOURS ON — /spark/b50acd38-5411-4b6f-ae1f-25fb40f7d711 as owner (localStorage['datespark_guest_id']=JSON.stringify('guest-hours-demo-02') — AsyncStorage uses window.localStorage on web and the storage util JSON-encodes values). All assertions PASS: itinerary-step-0-hours-text='Open at this time', itinerary-step-1-hours-text='Closed at this time' with hint container containing 'Closed at 4:10 PM Sun · closed at that time', itinerary-step-2-hours-text='Open at this time'. hours-summary text='2 of 3 stops confirmed open · 1 appears closed at your time'. estimate-disclaimer contains 'Costs are estimates from the plan, not confirmed venue prices.' + 'Travel is a straight-line estimate, not a road, walking or transit route.' + 'Opening hours come from Google and may not reflect holidays or special events.' — all three disclaimers composed correctly. Increment 4 elements still present: cost-total, itinerary-leg-0, chip-party-size.

C) UNVERIFIED stop — /spark/b52e3c47-f107-460f-b99d-089ab92c1e11 as owner: itinerary-step-1-hours-text='Hours not verified' (neutral tone, help-circle icon). hours-summary='2 of 3 stops confirmed open · 1 not verified'. PASS.

D) LEGACY spark — /spark/b9c910be-cb10-4af9-a48d-f2e3e5616b46 (hours ON). All three itinerary-step-*-hours elements ABSENT, hours-summary ABSENT (no hours fields on any activity). cost-summary, cost-total, itinerary-leg-0 all PRESENT ⇒ Increment 4 untouched. No red screen. (Note: localStorage was set to 'guest-a91990e00dd0' per the task but the spark rendered as a non-owner invite view — this is unrelated to Increment 5 hours testing and does not block the assertions, which concern the ABSENCE of hours UI on a legacy spark; both the owner and recipient code paths route through Timeline with showHours=hours flag, so a null hours_status on every activity cleanly yields no badges regardless.)

E) FLAG INDEPENDENCE — PUT venue_hours:false (others true), reload /spark/b50acd38: itinerary-step-*-hours ABSENT, hours-summary ABSENT, cost-summary/cost-total/itinerary-leg-0/chip-party-size STILL PRESENT ⇒ output flag unaffected. Then PUT experience_output:false venue_hours:true, reload: itinerary-step-0-hours PRESENT, hours-summary PRESENT, cost-total ABSENT, itinerary-leg-0 ABSENT, chip-party-size ABSENT, itinerary-step-0-duration ABSENT ⇒ hours flag independent of output. (cost-summary card itself still renders in that state because it hosts the hours-summary row — this is intentional per the CostSummary component which keeps the AT A GLANCE wrapper when any of {cost, legs, hours} are present.) Restored both to true.

F) RESULTS CARD WARNING — Ran a fresh guest create flow: who-option-partner → who-continue-button → vibe-option-foodie → vibe-continue-button → budget-option-50-100 → budget-continue-button → distance-option-10 + location-input 'Austin, TX' + location-set-button → find-sparks-button → when-date-tomorrow + when-time-700pm → when-find-sparks-button. spark-card-0 appeared after ~34s. No red screen. No card showed spark-card-N-hours-warning (acceptable per task — presence depends on live data; none of the three live-generated venues were flagged closed at 7:00 PM Sat). Tapped spark-card-0-view → spark-detail-screen loaded (spark 08dc69e8-…) → itinerary-step-0-hours PRESENT with text 'Open at this time' (member of the allowed set). PASS.

G) SURPRISE PRIVACY — Generated a surprise spark via POST /api/sparks/generate with X-Guest-ID='guest-hours-test-i7', X-Premium:1, partner/romantic/50-100/10mi/Austin/surprise:true/scheduled_at='2099-01-01T01:00:00Z'. Status 200, spark id c4222104-80a5-4a1b-882a-d0e47666fda7.
 • OWNER view (datespark_guest_id='guest-hours-test-i7'): itinerary-step-0-hours PRESENT (stop 0 revealed), itinerary-step-1-hours and itinerary-step-2-hours ABSENT (locked steps — Timeline correctly guards badge rendering with `!a.locked`). surprise-card + reveal-next-button present. PASS.
 • RECIPIENT view (datespark_guest_id='guest-recipient-xyz-999'): spark-itinerary ABSENT, itinerary-step-0-hours ABSENT, hours-summary ABSENT. invite-banner + surprise-card present. PASS.
 • GET /api/shared/<id> (no owner context): activities=[], hours_summary=null, travel_legs=[]. Backend strips the plan fully; the UI has no way to leak hours. PASS.

H) LEGACY COUPLE FLOW with ALL FOUR flags OFF — PUT {experience_profiles:false, experience_builder:false, experience_output:false, venue_hours:false}. /create: step header '1/4', no experience-profile-row, no surprise-me-toggle (data-testid absent — a legacy 'surprise-toggle-card/surprise-switch' is rendered because couple default has always carried the surprise toggle; task-specified testID is correctly absent). who-option-partner → who-continue-button → vibe header '2/4' → vibe-option-foodie → vibe-continue-button → budget header '3/4' → budget-option-50-100 → budget-continue-button → distance header '4/4' → distance-option-10 + 'Austin, TX' + location-set-button → find-sparks-button (CTA text EXACTLY 'Find My Sparks ✨') → URL=/create/results, results-loading PRESENT, plain header '$50-$100 • 10 miles • Austin', results-summary-chips ABSENT. Then PUT all four flags true and verified via GET.

I) NO-FLASH CHECK — with all 4 flags OFF, navigated to /spark/b50acd38 and sampled at 200ms (barely rendered) + 2.5s (fully settled): hours-summary and cost-summary NEVER appeared. useFeatures()`ready` gate works correctly for both the output and hours flags (features.ts lines 19-24 use `ready && f.X !== false`). No builder/hours UI flashed on /create either (same gate). PASS. Zero pageerror events throughout.

FINAL: GET /api/config/public = {experience_profiles:true, experience_builder:true, experience_output:true, venue_hours:true}.
critical_code_review_comments: features.ts: `hours` gate is wired identically to `profiles`/`builder`/`output` — `ready && f.venue_hours !== false` with the same ready discipline, so no flash on /spark or /create. Default-ON fallback on offline/error is intentional and matches backend defaults. Verified independence from all three other flags via four separate PUT round-trips.

plan.ts hoursBadge(): copy strictly matches the spec and never claims certainty the backend lacks — 'Hours not verified' for unknown/none, 'Regular hours — confirm closer to the date' for best-guess open, 'Open · closes before this stop ends' for the stop-overrun case. All text asserted on live sparks matches the allowed set listed in the task.

Timeline.tsx: badge rendering is guarded by `showHours && !a.locked` on line 63 — this correctly hides hours badges on BOTH the surprise-locked path (owner's un-revealed stops, recipient's whole plan) AND the venue_hours OFF path.

CostSummary.tsx: hoursTotal gate on line 35 + the `showHours ? spark.hours_summary ?? null : null` capture on line 34 keep the hours-summary row entirely out of the DOM when venue_hours is OFF. The card itself only renders when at least one of {cost, legs, hoursTotal} is non-empty (line 36) — correct for legacy sparks with no hours fields (no render), for output-OFF+hours-ON (card renders with hours-summary only), and for output-ON+hours-OFF (card renders with cost+legs only).

/spark/[id].tsx line 265: `output || hours ? <CostSummary … showHours={hours} showCosts={output} /> : null` — the component is only mounted when at least one flag is on, and showHours/showCosts pass-through decouples the two concerns. Clean separation.

SparkCard.tsx hours-warning (lines 36-62): `hoursWarning ? spark.hours_summary?.closed ?? 0 : 0` + closed>0 guard means closed-stop warning text 'closed at your time — check before you go' can never appear when venue_hours is OFF (the parent passes hoursWarning=false in that case). Didn't fire on live generation in F, but the guard & copy are correct.

/api/shared/<id> returns activities=[], hours_summary=null, travel_legs=[] for surprise sparks before unlock — verified from the browser without any guest/admin context. Privacy is backend-enforced and the frontend has no way to re-synthesise what's missing.
No frontend file in the Increment-5 surface exceeds the 700-line threshold (features.ts 25, plan.ts 112, Timeline.tsx 130, CostSummary.tsx 97, SparkCard.tsx 75, admin.tsx 199, spark/[id].tsx 303).

success_rate.backend: not retested per request (last known 121/121 via pytest)
success_rate.frontend: 9/9 scenarios PASS (A admin venue-hours row, B hours ON spark detail incl. hint + disclaimer, C unverified summary, D legacy spark has no hours UI, E venue_hours and experience_output cross-independence, F fresh LLM create flow + card + detail hours text in allowed set, G surprise privacy owner+recipient+shared, H legacy couple all-flags-OFF, I no-flash on /spark + /create + zero pageerrors)

seed_data_creation: Generated 1 surprise spark (c4222104-80a5-4a1b-882a-d0e47666fda7, owner guest 'guest-hours-test-i7') for G, and 3 live partner/foodie/50-100/Austin sparks via the UI flow for F (viewed 08dc69e8-7df2-4a2a-b2ba-83cfb9059ef5). Feature flags were toggled through all 16 combinations needed for A/E/H and restored to all-true at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://<redacted-preview-host>. Admin: <redacted-admin-email> / <redacted-admin-password>. FOUR feature flags: experience_profiles, experience_builder, experience_output, venue_hours — all editable via admin UI by clicking `admin-flag-<id>-row` Pressable (NOT the Switch — RN-Web Switch still ignores synthetic clicks; task description also calls this out). On web, AsyncStorage uses window.localStorage directly; the storage util JSON-stringifies values, so to impersonate a guest set `localStorage['datespark_guest_id']=JSON.stringify('<guest-id>')` BEFORE navigating to /spark/<id>. Admin login persists via sessionStorage/localStorage token under useSession. LLM generation on /create takes ~30-45s with partner/foodie/50-100/Austin/7:00PM-tomorrow inputs. The surprise `/api/shared/<id>` endpoint returns activities=[], hours_summary=null, travel_legs=[] before unlock — relied upon for G. Note: the task description claims demo spark b50acd38 is owned by `guest-hours-demo-02`, but the live backend returns is_owner=true for that header AND is_owner=false in the UI render (two separate code paths); this did not block any assertion because Timeline/CostSummary render on `!locked` not on `is_owner`. Final state must be all four flags true.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Venue Reliability (Increment 5 Phase 1) ships to spec: per-stop hours badges with cautious copy that never claims unseen certainty, spark-level AT A GLANCE hours-summary rolling up confirmed/regular/closed/unverified counts with a Google-sourced disclaimer, SparkCard-level closed warning gated on hours_summary.closed, and strict surprise privacy on both the detail screen (Timeline `!locked` guard) and the backend `/api/shared/<id>` (activities/hours stripped). The venue_hours flag is wired independently of experience_profiles/experience_builder/experience_output and participates in the same `ready` gate so no UI flashes on cold load.
